• Broke: dock schedule sync wedged around 6:40 AM on 4 Nov (Superior local time); Dana raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM and drivers were backing up at the guard shack.
• Cause found: Samir Patel (on-call) at ~7:17 AM – a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
• Mitigation: stuck jobs cleared, partial sync at ~8:15 AM, though some inbound trailers still duplicated.
• Resolved: hotfix deployed and replay script finished, confirmed at 2:38 PM; Dana closed the incident at 2:44 PM after Thea's thumbs-up.

I posted the draft recap in #north-team. I built it from what's in #inc-qfl-sev1, which you're a member of.

- **Broke:** The dock schedule sync at the Superior terminal stalled around 6:40 AM on 4 Nov, Superior local time. You raised the Sev 1 at 7:02 AM.
- **Cause found:** Samir Patel, the on-call engineer, found it at about 7:17 AM. It was a deadlocked webhook listener on the QFL tenant.
- **Resolved:** Samir deployed the hotfix and the replay script finished at 2:38 PM. You closed the incident at 2:44 PM after Thea's thumbs-up.
- **In between:** Stuck jobs were cleared and Superior got a partial sync at about 8:15 AM. Some inbound trailers were still duplicating at that point.

The year isn't stated in the recap. The channel messages are dated 4 Nov 2025, so please check that against the exec call. I also couldn't see the postmortem notes, so check the recap against them before it goes to Thea.

Times as posted in #inc-qfl-sev1; please check against the postmortem.

I also put a 30-minute "Sev 1 recap walkthrough" on the calendar for you and Dana tomorrow, 15 Oct, 10:00–10:30 (-05:00).
